scenes.title: Rent day runs itself
scenes.sub: A Chainlink CRE workflow is the house's treasurer
scenes.say: In Vesta, housemates pay their share into one rent pot. Nobody has to collect it, and nobody has to chase. A Chainlink Runtime Environment workflow runs rent day for every house.

scenes.title: Read the chain, check the world
scenes.sub: Monad state plus a live FX API, agreed by consensus
scenes.say: Once a day, the workflow reads every house straight from the HouseVault contract on Monad. It fetches the live exchange rate from an outside API, and the nodes agree on the median. Then it decides: is rent due and the pot full, or is someone behind?

scenes.title: A signed report back onchain
scenes.sub: Only the Chainlink forwarder can move the pot
scenes.say: Each decision becomes a signed report, written back to the vault through the Chainlink forwarder. The vault only accepts reports from the forwarder, so nobody can pay out early, or flag a housemate by hand.

scenes.title: Three days out, someone is short
scenes.sub: A real simulation, broadcast to Monad testnet
scenes.say: Here's a real run against Monad testnet. A house is due soon, and one housemate has only paid half. The workflow reads eight houses, checks the rate, and flags the shortfall onchain.

scenes.title: Flagged onchain
scenes.sub: The house sees it before rent day, not after
scenes.say: The proof is on chain. A RentShortfall event, sent through Chainlink's forwarder, showing exactly who is short and by how much. Vesta's feed and steward pick it up straight away.

scenes.title: Rent day: the pot is full
scenes.say: The housemate tops up. On rent day the workflow runs again, sees a full pot, and pays the landlord.

scenes.title: Landlord paid, on the day
scenes.sub: No reminders, no transfers, no chasing
scenes.say: Rent collected, and the landlord paid in AUSD, in one transaction. That's Chainlink CRE as Vesta's orchestration layer: real data in, onchain action out, for every house, every month.

outro.title: Vesta
outro.sub: Rent day runs itself. Powered by Chainlink CRE.
